description: The API token is invalid or malformed.
cause: The provided Bearer token is incorrect or no longer valid.
resolution: Verify the API token and send it using the Authorization Bearer Token header.

description: The API request does not include an authentication token.
cause: The Authorization header is missing or does not contain a Bearer token.
resolution: Provide a valid API token in the Authorization header.

description: The authenticated account does not have permission to perform the requested operation.
cause: The API token does not have sufficient access for the requested resource or action.
resolution: Verify the account permissions and use a token with the required access.

description: The API request rate limit has been exceeded.
cause: The account has exceeded its plan rate limit of 60 requests per minute for Pro or 300 requests per minute for Enterprise.
resolution: Wait before retrying and reduce request frequency to remain within the applicable plan limit.

description: The request must be retried after the rate limit window resets.
cause: Too many requests were submitted within the current rate limit window.
resolution: Wait and retry the request after the rate limit window resets.

description: The requested ticket could not be found.
cause: The specified ticket_id does not exist or is not accessible.
resolution: Verify the ticket_id and retry the request.

cause: The request contains a status value other than open pending resolved or closed.
resolution: Use one of the supported ticket statuses: open pending resolved or closed.

cause: The request contains a priority value other than low medium high or urgent.
resolution: Use one of the supported ticket priorities: low medium high or urgent.

description: A required ticket field is missing.
cause: The request does not provide a required field such as customer_id subject or description.
resolution: Add the missing required field and submit the request again.

description: The requested customer could not be found.
cause: The specified customer_id does not exist or is not accessible.
resolution: Verify the customer_id and retry the request.

description: The customer email address is invalid.
cause: The email value does not use a valid email address format.
resolution: Provide a valid customer email address and retry the request.

description: A required customer field is missing.
cause: The request does not provide a required customer field such as name or email.
resolution: Add the missing required field and submit the request again.

cause: The configured webhook endpoint did not successfully accept the HTTPS POST request.
resolution: Check the receiving endpoint and connectivity; FlowDesk will retry failed deliveries up to 3 times.

description: The webhook endpoint is invalid or cannot be used.
cause: The configured endpoint is not a valid HTTPS endpoint.
resolution: Provide a valid HTTPS webhook endpoint and verify that it can receive POST requests.

description: The webhook endpoint did not respond within the delivery window.
cause: The receiving HTTPS endpoint took too long to respond.
resolution: Check the endpoint response time and availability; FlowDesk will retry the failed delivery up to 3 times.
